The customer triggered a return after a software checksum alert appeared during their incoming inspection. The modules are physically intact, but I cannot sign the release plan until I've heard from test engineering, maintenance, warehouse logistics, and regulatory compliance. Let's go through each report so we can determine the right disposition. Who would like to start?
